summary: Columbia Banking System, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per common share, payable June 15, 2026 to shareholders of record as of May 29, 2026. The dividend is a recurring capital return event, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations catalyst is present. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; monitor future dividend declarations for sustainability or changes.
